description: Proxy subscription collection, verification, and formatting pipeline with Cloudflare Workers deployment

architecture.overview: Cloudflare Worker heartbeat (15 min) wakes the pipeline. The freshness watchdog decides whether to re-collect or re-probe. main.py collects and verifies; probe-egress measures the published pool. A Cloudflare Worker serves subscriptions from the published feed.

scheduling.heartbeat_interval: 15 minutes (Cloudflare cron */15 - a different platform from GitHub's best-effort scheduler)
scheduling.wake_path: heartbeat Worker POSTs repository_dispatch(heartbeat) -> freshness-watchdog.yml evaluates and dispatches
decisions: pool older than 30 min -> gh workflow run update.yml (re-collect; it chains its own probe)
health older than 10 min -> gh workflow run probe-egress.yml
both stale -> update wins (its chained probe covers the health side)
both fresh, or a heavy run is already queued/running -> no-op
scheduling.chaining: update.yml fires probe-egress.yml with `gh workflow run` as soon as a build publishes, so the probe measures the pool that was just published
scheduling.github_schedule_crons: NONE. Free-tier schedule: crons stopped firing 2026-10-01 and froze the pipeline; the clock now lives on Cloudflare.
scheduling.db_update_interval: ~30 min (the watchdog re-collects once the pool document passes 30 min of age)
scheduling.probe_interval: ~10-15 min (health >10 min old, plus chained after every update)

data_flow: 3. DNS prewarm (32 threads) -> TCP probe -> HTTPS gate -> speed test
4. Country verification via DB-IP Lite MMDB + ip-api (roaming egress pool)
5. Output: all.txt + countries/<CC>.txt (+ base64, manifest.json, source_map.json, ATTRIBUTION.txt) to gh-pages
6. proxy-egress-ip-check Worker measures egress IPs for the probe workflow; probe-egress publishes egress-health.json
7. proxy-chain-subscription Worker serves chained subscriptions from the published feed
8. freshness-watchdog.yml keeps the chain from stalling

upstream_sources.0xRadikal: Primary source: raw.githubusercontent.com/0xRadikal/Free-v2ray-Configs/main/verified/configs.txt (23.6% yield measured 2026-10-16 on the repaired tester - the only feed that earns its cost)
upstream_sources.patterniha/Free-Configs: REMOVED (0.0% yield in two full runs, 278 candidates; its pinned edge is TCP-dead and its SNI names are dropped at the TLS handshake from inside Iran - killed 2026-10-16)

proxy-chain-subscription.file: index.js (1417 lines, 60833 bytes, committed as the deployed bundle - this is esbuild output, not original source)
proxy-chain-subscription.purpose: Subscription endpoint. Reads a base64 entrypoint (entry64), chains feed exits behind it with dialer-proxy, and renders the result in the client's format.
proxy-chain-subscription.format_detection: User-Agent first (clash/mihomo/stash -> mihomo, sing-box/nekobox -> sing-box, xray/v2rayng/mahsa -> links); ?format= overrides

query_options.format: mihomo | sing-box | xray | links (clash and clash-meta alias to mihomo)
query_options.entry64: base64 proxy URI for an entrypoint; repeatable, deduplicated, capped at MAX_ENTRIES
query_options.secure: secure=1 keeps only exits whose hop is TLS; 503 no_tls_exits_in_feed when none survive
query_options.ech: ech=embed pins Cloudflare's ECH key into the config; default leaves it to the client's DNS (query-server-name), because mihomo has no ECHRejectionError recovery

proxy-chain-subscription.size_behavior: No size caps. Entry count, entry length, and response size are all unbounded; the full feed is rendered. COUNTRY_CAP (60 exits per country, except the ZZ-RAINBOW bucket which is uncapped) is the only output-size control.
proxy-chain-subscription.feed: raw.githubusercontent.com/TheCalmBoy/proxy-collector/gh-pages/{all.txt | countries/<CC>.txt}, fetched with a 60s edge cache (cf.cacheTtl/cacheEverything)
proxy-chain-subscription.tests: test/*.mjs run with `node --test`; scripts/verify-chain.sh parses the rendered YAML, starts mihomo, fetches through the chain, and reports the egress country

proxy-egress-ip-check.purpose: Egress IP verification. Downloads a payload and streams it back so the probe can measure real throughput.

proxy-pipeline-heartbeat.source: heartbeat/index.js (64 lines) - the readable source, with its wrangler.jsonc
proxy-pipeline-heartbeat.committed_bundle: workers/proxy-pipeline-heartbeat/index.js (73 lines) - a superseded copy of the same Worker's build output
proxy-pipeline-heartbeat.purpose: 15-min Cloudflare cron. POSTs repository_dispatch(heartbeat) to GitHub. Stateless per dispatch: one POST, no decisions, no KV counter - freshness-watchdog.yml decides what to run.

update.yml.name: Update Proxy Database
update.yml.cron: None (never scheduled; woken by the watchdog)

probe-egress.yml.name: Probe proxy egress IPs
probe-egress.yml.trigger: workflow_dispatch + chained from update.yml + dispatched by freshness-watchdog.yml
probe-egress.yml.cron: None (chained, so it always measures the just-published pool)

inputs.probe_concurrency: concurrent 5 MB speed tests through sing-box, default 50

freshness-watchdog.yml.name: Freshness Watchdog
freshness-watchdog.yml.permissions: actions: write (it dispatches the heavy workflows)
freshness-watchdog.yml.guard: freshness_watch.py --check-active skips a dispatch when a heavy run is queued/running or already finished recently

test.yml.name: Test
test.yml.runs: the Python suite only (python -m unittest discover -s tests). The Worker node tests are NOT wired into CI.

s3diag.yml.name: Stage 3 Diagnostics
s3diag.yml.purpose: Classifies why each candidate failed the download gate, and whether it can reach strict sites (tools/s3diag.py). NOT Amazon S3.

main.py.purpose: Core collection pipeline; writes output/ (all.txt, countries/, base64, manifest.json, source_map.json, ATTRIBUTION.txt)

python_source.run_tests.py: Runs the test suite without a container or package install; `python3 run_tests.py [name-fragment]`

tools/.verify.py: 76424 bytes - TCP/HTTP/Speed gates and proxy scoring

tests.worker: workers/proxy-chain-subscription/test/*.mjs (chain integrity, health headers, byte limits, ECH shapes, secure filter, embed coverage)

history.2026-10-01: GitHub free-tier schedule: crons stopped firing for this repo and froze the pipeline - the watchdog meant to recover it shared the same scheduler. Fixed by moving the clock to a Cloudflare Worker (heartbeat/).
history.2026-10-11: patterniha/Free-Configs added as a second source.
history.2026-10-15: ECH output format corrected; round-robin across entrypoints fixed; whole-node byte capping; direct rules for private ranges; ?secure=1 and ?ech=embed added.
history.2026-10-16: The three size caps (per-entry bytes, entry count, response bytes) were removed: the worker now renders the whole feed. They only ever mattered for an unauthenticated public endpoint, and they cost a binary-search re-render whenever the feed grew. The tester's six silent field losses were fixed the same day (reality emitted without enabled, alpn, insecure, fp, httpupgrade/h2, hy2/tuic/anytls, vmess tls) - 0xRadikal 13.46% -> 23.61%, whitedns 5.96% -> 15.17%. patterniha/Free-Configs was removed at 0.0% in two full runs (dead pinned edge, handshake-dropped SNI names measured from inside Iran).
